ceu: ✦ The sextile between the Sun and Pluto

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.
From {H:1806090190000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.

The sextile between the Sun and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your image and friendships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: End the day with a minute of gratitude for what has changed in you.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.
From {H:1806090190000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.

The sextile between the Sun and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your inner life and your career: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Pluto brings depth and transformation. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to your partner or to a close friend.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.
From {H:1806090190000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.

The sextile between the Sun and Pluto brings together, in your favour, friendships and your horizons: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Swap a snack for fruit and notice how you feel.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.
From {H:1806090190000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.

The sextile between the Sun and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your career and intimacy: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Dance at home, even if it is just to one song.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.
From {H:1806090190000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.

The sextile between the Sun and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your horizons and relationships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Open the windows in the morning and let fresh air into your home.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.
From {H:1806090190000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to home and family.

The sextile between the Sun and Pluto brings together, in your favour, intimacy and routine: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Pluto brings depth and transformation. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Before reacting to a message, read it twice.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.
From {H:1806090190000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.

The sextile between the Sun and Pluto brings together, in your favour, relationships and romance: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Think of a way to make one of your talents pay off.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.
From {H:1806090190000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.

The sextile between the Sun and Pluto brings together, in your favour, routine and family: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Start something new today, however small.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.
From {H:1806090190000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.

The sextile between the Sun and Pluto brings together, in your favour, romance and conversations: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Pluto brings depth and transformation. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Spend five minutes in silence before going to sleep.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.
From {H:1806090190000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.

The sextile between the Sun and Pluto brings together, in your favour, family and money: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Write down a dream and three steps to get there.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.
From {H:1806090190000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.

With Mars retrograde in your relationships sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Set aside an hour without interruptions for what matters most.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.
From {H:1806090190000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.

The sextile between the Sun and Pluto brings together, in your favour, money and your inner life: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Pluto brings depth and transformation. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Teach someone something you know well.
